address: Schöne Aussicht 2, Frankfurt on the Main, 60311, Germany
bio: The restaurant in the Literaturhaus, set on the banks of the Main, has an extremely stylish and upscale interior. The large bar area and the striking portraits of international figures from the arts draw the eye as you savour food that tends towards the classical. The adjoining Kaminzimmer (fireplace room) is also very pleasant. Plenty of places to park behind the restaurant. This address is also ideal as an event location....
